lists.detailEmptyBody: Add a word from its entry page.
lists.detailNotFound: This list was not found on this device.

review.heading: Review {{name}}

review.flipBack: Tap the card to turn it back.

nudge.title: Daily review
nudge.body: Here are {{count}} saved words from your lists to review today.

history.metaDescription: A record of the words you look up.
history.emptyBody: Searches are recorded on this device only. They are never sent to the server.
history.clearBody: This removes every recorded search on this device. This cannot be undone.
history.capNote: Only the 500 most recent searches, and nothing older than 90 days, are kept.

settings.metaDescription: Change the app language and color theme.
settings.appearanceBody: The theme switch in the header works today. Controls for your translation languages will live here once they are built.
settings.languageBody: Choose the language for the buttons and labels in the app. This does not change the languages you translate.
settings.publicNameBody: The name shown beside a question you choose to put your name on. It appears on the public pages only for questions where you switch it on.
settings.publicNameInvalid: Use 2 to 32 characters: letters, numbers, spaces, and . _ -
settings.hideNewExplanationsByDefaultBody: Choose whether your future explanations start out hidden from other readers.
settings.installBody: Install the app on this device. It then opens from your home screen and starts without the browser bar.
settings.installStepsIos: Open the Share menu in the browser, then choose "Add to Home Screen".
settings.installStepsAndroid: Open the browser menu, then choose "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".
settings.installStepsDesktop: Open the browser menu, then choose "Install". Some browsers show an install icon in the address bar.
settings.installedNote: The app is installed on this device. Open it from your home screen.

account.title: Account
account.signedOutBody: You need an account to search and keep lists. Create one, or sign in.
account.signedInBody: Sign in with this address on another device to see your lists there.
account.createBody: We send an email with a link. Open the link, then sign in.
account.checkInboxBody: If that address is valid, a link is on the way. It works for one day.
account.mailFailed: The email could not be sent. Try again.
account.verifyInvalidBody: It was used, or it expired. Enter your address to get a new link.
account.signInFailed: Address and password do not match a confirmed account.
account.verifyFirst: Your password is correct. Click the link we emailed you, then sign in. Request another link below.
account.forgotBody: Enter your address. If an account exists, we send an email with a link.
account.forgotSentBody: If an account exists for that address, a link is on the way.
account.resetBody: This signs out your other devices.
account.resetInvalidBody: It was used, or it expired. Request a new link.
account.changePasswordBody: Your other devices are signed out. This device stays signed in.
account.passwordChangedToast: Your password is changed. Other devices are signed out.
account.deleteConfirmBody: Your words, lists and history go with it. This cannot be undone.
account.exportBody: A JSON file with your lists, saved words, notes, and search history from this device.
account.exportEmpty: There is nothing saved to export.
account.signOutBody: Your lists are sent to your account, then removed from this device. Sign in again to restore them.
account.deleteBody: The account and your server copy are removed. Enter your password to confirm.

attribution.metaDescription: Data sources behind this dictionary, with licences and attribution.
